target_customer: AI engineering teams building LLM applications and agents
problem: Teams struggle to pick the best model per prompt for quality, speed and cost, and later that frozen models do not improve from usage.
business_model: Usage-based API (router) moving to continual learning platform
product_category: LLM routing, then continual learning infrastructure

founders.name: Daniel Lenton
education: Imperial College London, PhD in machine learning for 3D vision and robotics
founders.background_notes: Education from a search result snippet quoting the YC profile; the opened YC page itself listed no education.

technical_complexity.rationale: Neural routing across models and now continual learning is research-grade for a three-person team.

defensibility.rationale: Routers are thin layers over provider APIs and many rivals existed later; continual learning could add proprietary data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed it by 2026 per sources found; routing became a crowded category.

market_need_then: Few LLM applications existed at founding; the need for model routing grew with the 2023 model proliferation.

branding.domain_note: Uses unify.ai; a separate company Unify (unifygtm) raised money in the same period, causing name collisions.

identity.logo: Lowercase unify wordmark per the website
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise with a Memento film reference

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name colliding with other Unify companies; no brand-specific coverage found.

pivots.to: Continual learning models that train from user interactions
pivots.why: Not stated; the website pitches models that keep learning. Date not found.

outcome_analysis: Unify raised an 8 million dollar seed in May 2024 on an LLM routing pitch with notable backers, then repositioned toward continual learning. Routing became a crowded category, so the pivot is a hedge. No exit, shutdown or later round was found.
notes: One source says 8.5M total; the seed is recorded as 8M. Sources disagree on who led. Pivot date unknown. No 2022 dated competitor sources found (results were 2026 comparison pages), so the list is empty.
